process: Original independent text-to-image cutaway materials. Unity samples each at a fixed world pixel pitch and derives local shading from adjacent texture samples. The base texture retains its original PNG in the source project.
designReference: Thomas Vasseur and Gwenaël Massé described using volume cues and changing light in Dead Cells. Reference for art direction, no assets used from Dead Cells.

images.prompt: Game-ready seamless environment material, a single full-bleed horizontally continuous side-on cutaway of the top of a solid platform. Wide panoramic 3:1 image. Visual rendering: masterful highly art-directed low resolution pixel art approximating a 384x128 sprite, bold legible hand-clustered hard pixels, painterly hierarchy of shapes and economical highlights, delicately beveled relief illuminated from upper left under moonlight, deep blue-violet shadows preserving midtones, no black outlines unless structural, absolutely no photographic noise or blurry textures. Upper edge of frame must be ENTIRELY filled with a thin continuous flat horizontal walkway cap touching the TOP ROW, no sky no air above and no isolated floating tile, no scalloped upper silhouette. Everything below the top 7% is the continuous vertical cut face of the ground, with a rich interesting middle section and darker subdued lower edge. Make large naturally joined masses, physical depth between layers, selective rim light and ambient occlusion. Composition repeats left-to-right without a focal point or ends or borders. Orthographic side elevation, VERY shallow glimpse of top surface. No lettering, UI, frame or characters, no backdrop. Rural Vietnamese village raised earth embankment: tamped ochre walking path flecked with tiny olive grass clumps on the top edge, warm umber clay over dark compact laterite, embedded slate stones in irregular groups and a few pencil-thin herb roots, broad cool shadow shapes, ochre/lavender reflected moonlight. Dominated by soil, not a brick wall. Real geological grounding for an ancient village gate.
